title: cd4backcalc
text: demonstrate process fitting back-calculation model need first simulate diagnosis data. Data simulated propagating number HIV infections back-calculation model generate diagnoses time. can define simulation configuration using define_sim_config function. function allows us specify whether include migration status, RITA status, /age groups simulation, well varying patterns model parameters, e.g. h_pattern controls pattern HIV incidence time can set “constant”, “linear”, “quadratic”. case real data used, simulation step can skipped, migration, rita, age parameters can passed directly run_backcalc function formatted stan_data. simulate_diagnoses function uses configuration simulate HIV diagnoses time.
code: ## simulate data stan_data <- simulate_diagnoses(migration = FALSE, rita = FALSE, age = FALSE)

title: cd4backcalc
text: Next, run_backcalc function used fit back-calculation model simulated diagnosis data using specified model configuration. model fitting uses cmdstanr package additional options can passed control MCMC sampling process (e.g. number iterations, number chains, etc).

title: cd4backcalc
text: Convergence MCMC chains can assessed using cmdstanr package functions traceplot stan_rhat. Additionally, cd4backcalc package provides convenience function plot_diagnostics plot key diagnostics fitted model.

text: hiv_list object returned post-processing can now compared simulated data using goodness fit tests bias. multiple models fitted complementary mean squared error (MSE) plot can used. step can omitted models fitted simulated data.

title: CD4 Back-Calculation R package
text: cd4backcalc package provides user-friendly way perform Bayesian, discrete-time, multi-state modelling estimate HIV incidence undiagnosed HIV prevalence diagnosis data.

title: CD4 Back-Calculation R package
text: CD4 back-calculation discrete-time, multi-state Markov model used represent HIV progression different states diagnosis. undiagnosed (latent) states model represent decreasing CD4 strata, may include recent HIV acquisition (defined using RITA evidence), migration status, age group. illustration latent diagnosed states CD4-staged back-calculation model shown . Models fitted within Bayesian framework (using cmdstanr), suitable prior distributions, estimate HIV incidence prevalence undiagnosed HIV time, well probabilities diagnosis CD4 state. Figure: CD4-staged back-calculation model. model compartments represent undiagnosed HIV (round boxes) diagnosed HIV AIDS (square boxes); hjh_j arrow represents HIV acquired time point (jj); HIV progression probabilities (qiq_i) vary CD4 stratum; HIV diagnosis probabilities (di,jd_{,j}) vary CD4 stratum time.

title: CD4 Back-Calculation R package

code: # install.packages(c("pak", "gitcreds")) gitcreds::gitcreds_set() # set your PAT in the prompt pak::pak("pkirwan/cd4backcalc")

title: CD4 Back-Calculation R package
text: cd4backcalc package requires R package cmdstanr (available CRAN) command-line interface Stan, CmdStan. See instructions : Getting started CmdStanR. Windows users additionally require Rtools compile Stan models, see: https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/. MacOS users require correct GNU Fortran compiler, see: https://mac.r-project.org/tools/.

title: CD4 Back-Calculation R package
text: basic workflow simulate diagnosis data fit CD4-staged back-calculation model, check convergence goodness fit simulated data, plot model estimates shown example .
code: library(cd4backcalc)  # simulate data under an increasing incidence scenario sim_diags <- simulate_diagnoses(h_pattern = "increasing")  # visualise simulated data plot_simulations(sim_diags, quantity = "incidence") # run back-calculation model on simulated data # default is 2000 iterations and 4 chains hiv_list <- run_backcalc(sim_diags)  # check convergence plot_diagnostics(hiv_list) # check goodness of fit bias_plot(hiv_list, quantity = "incidence") # plot estimates compared to simulated values plot_estimates(hiv_list, quantity = "incidence")

title: CD4 Back-Calculation R package
text: cd4backcalc package includes several pre-compiled models can used fit back-calculation model real simulated diagnosis data different scenarios: Age-independent age-dependent CD4-CD4 + RITA data without migration functions package designed work model variants, appropriate model selected based user-specified options. table shows options used combination RITA evidence, migration status, age structure. N.B. Due increased complexity, fitting times can substantially longer using age-dependent models.

title: Define simulation type — define_simulation_type
text: List available simulation types: "constant": parameters constant time. "h_increasing": Infections increase time. "h_varying": Infections vary time. "o_increasing": Migration (omega) increases time. "o_step_change": Migration (omega) step changes time. "d_varying": Diagnosis probabilities vary time. "p_increasing": Proportion UK increases time. "m_differing": Migration probabilities (mu) differ diagnosed state. "m_varying": Migration probabilities (mu) vary time. "combo_1": Combination varying infections, step change migration, varying diagnosis probabilities. "combo_2": Combination varying infections, step change migration, varying diagnosis probabilities, increasing proportion UK. "combo_3": Combination varying infections, step change migration, varying diagnosis probabilities, increasing proportion UK, varying migration probabilities. "combo_3_no_migration": Similar "combo_3" without migration effects. "combo_4": "combo_3" different incidence migration patterns.
